scope: Source-defined leaf cases in three selected suites, including separately categorized resource conversion. Metadata only; no Rust implementation or validator fixture changes.

normal_execution_assumptions: Selected pinned Bazel target definitions, ordinary JUnit4 dispatch, no user-supplied agp.version/gradle.version/test_filter/ignored.tests.only overrides.
JUnit4.13.2 comes from the pinned idea library metadata. Its source jar is retained externally with a SHA-256; it is supplementary runner evidence, not a new Android reference baseline.
Compiled jar membership, actual JVM descriptions, shard assignment and reference test execution were not run or claimed. Retry/repeat infrastructure is not counted as a distinct input case.
inheritance: AllVariantsSyncWithGradleSyncExecutorTest implements SnapshotComparisonTest; the fully inspected interface has no Test-annotated methods. No test superclass, RunWith, Parameters, factory or dynamic-case declaration exists in this selected class.
GradleSyncSpecialCasesIntegrationTest has no test superclass or custom runner; it declares one Test method and project/Expect rules.
GradleAndroidModelTest explicitly uses RunWith(JUnit4), has no test superclass/rules and declares one inline resource-conversion method.

TestGroup considers public inherited methods; JUnit TestClass scans the concrete class and superclasses. Here all three Kotlin classes have Object as their superclass, so no inherited leaf test is omitted. Kotlin interface/default-argument accessors are not Test-annotated methods.
runner_resolution.rule_and_helper_dispatch: AndroidProjectRule returns/delegates one wrapped statement, NamedExternalResource evaluates it once, TestName/TestWatcher and Truth Expect evaluate once, and prepared-project/fixture helpers invoke the callback once. RunsInEdt changes dispatch context, not invocation count.
runner_resolution.environment_selection: For the three sync leaf cases in the normal integration target, prepareTestProject selects AGP_CURRENT=AGP_LATEST once. ModelVersion defaults V2. Default AGP/Gradle/Kotlin/JDK versions are resolved by the harness; they are not enumerated into parameter instances. Separate generated targets were inspected independently before this conclusion.
runner_resolution.snapshot_selection: Phased/baseline suffixes select a comparison file for the same assertion. The pinned selected snapshot directory contains only three baseline files and no phased variants; selected methods use allVariantSyncWithV2.txt and allVariantWithBuildSrc.txt. The duplicate-snapshot assertion remains part of each method's future port requirements.

excluded_snapshot.reason: Retained externally. No testAllVariantSyncWithV1 declaration exists in the full selected suite; a stale V1/V2 class comment and this file do not create a test case. No N/A classification or deletion was performed.

target_inventory.version_inputs: Normal target defines no AGP/Gradle version properties or split configurations. Four shards distribute methods; they do not define four AGP inputs. The full module BUILD defines no generated old-AGP targets.

The class matches none of the explicitly named split filters in the complete BUILD. The other split excludes those filters, enables indexing, and supplies jbr-next. This method does not run Gradle or read version/configuration inputs; its conversion helper uses only class field values.

Explicit manual local-development alias generated by _gen_split_tests. Indexing defaults differ from other, but the selected pure conversion method has identical literal inputs and no indexing/AGP/Gradle interaction. It is recorded as a target alias for the same input case, not silently discarded or counted as a parameter instance.

target_inventory.reason: The full generated target definition and OldAgpFilter were inspected. GradleAndroidModelTest has no OldAgpTest annotation, so ignore_other_tests=true excludes it. The three selected integration methods belong to a different module jar. Old-AGP inputs were not collapsed to AGP_CURRENT.

uncredited_suite_infrastructure.execution_condition: Suite finalizer executes once per successful JarTestSuiteRunner target; its method assumes idea.leak.check.enabled=true. It is not inherited by a selected leaf class or invoked once per selected method.
uncredited_suite_infrastructure.reason: Retained and cited for the later global suite/infrastructure census. This bounded inventory makes no inapplicability classification or claim to cover all tests in the containing module targets.

fixture_preservation.preservation: Full selected directories and suites were extracted unchanged from the pinned full idea archive. Every file hash was checked against existing per-file fixture provenance; original notices and binary fixture bytes remain external. Canonical rows record all immediate fixture paths/hashes.
harness_adaptations_required_for_future_: Preserve original fixture bytes, then reproduce or explain original harness patches: AGP/Kotlin/tooling versions, local repositories, SDK/build-tools/compileSdk/targetSdk, Gradle wrapper creation and configured JDK.
TemplateBasedTestProject migrates manifest package attributes to namespaces for applicable AGP versions; original helper setup and library targetSdk compatibility patches must be respected.

Generated-manifest test moves lib/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml into lib/build/generated/manifests/AndroidManifest.xml and appends sourceSets.main.manifest.srcFile before project import/sync. Both virtual-file presence and project Android association must be ported.

All-variant tests require normal-sync count1, non-null fetched all-variant model, count12 or2, full Android/dependency snapshot equality and duplicate-snapshot validation. Checking counts alone is insufficient.
fixture_preservation.licensing: AOSP source carries Apache2.0 notices retained in external originals. Immediate fixture files without individual notices remain identified by model-sync-fixture-provenance.json; redistribution audit remains required before copying fixtures into product/test source. JUnit runner sources are EPL1.0; Truth sources are Apache2.0. No third-party runner source was adapted into Rust.

remaining_limits: No generated compiled test jars, IntelliJ/JBR/Android SDK/offline Maven runtime or Bazel descriptions were built/executed here. Source-defined leaf cases and dispatch conditions are resolved for the named targets; actual executed cases are not credited.

Exact AGP dev version, default Gradle/Kotlin/JDK artifacts and project dump rendering depend on the pinned build and prebuilts. A future Rust port must bind and document that executable environment; using arbitrary newer versions cannot earn parity credit.

Other model-sync classes, old-AGP suites, suite finalizers, global inherited/generated cases, platform/configuration variants and target discovery remain outside this bounded task. Census flags remain false and mirror omissions remain unverified.
Pure metadata/catalog changes do not implement sync, project import, generated manifest handling or resource conversion in the IDE. All four new rows remain unported/not_run.

SnapshotComparisonTest is an interface with no Test methods; phased/baseline suffixes are file-selection candidates, not JUnit instances.
